override.title: Admin ọbọraid
override.hint: Override jao ge amak’ admin o̱ro̱m ar karon salak’ lọg huyuk’ kana - tis hõ thir baṅ huyuk’ kana.
override.cancelBookingHint: Baṅ kạmi lekhan booking ar ona reaḱ komison do̠ baṅ hoe akana mente cinhạe uduga, ona do̠ kạmiạko ṭhen kạmi reaḱ mạlik ruạṛe emda, ar kạmiạko do̠ noa lead arhõ booking ko emda.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Noa buking bạtil me̱? Ona reaḱ komison hõ baṅ hoe akana. Noa do̠ amaḱ ńutum ar karon te̠ log akana.

detail.disputeOpen: Noa gạhki cetanre mit́ṭen mạlik biḍạu jhić akana - eṭaḱ gạhki doe meneda, noa do onkoaḱ kana. Ona do̠ Disputes page re̠ge̠ bicạr hoyoḱ kana.

cancellation.title: Buking baṅ hoe akana
cancellation.hint: Buking ar ona reak̕ komison do̠ baṅ hoeakana; kạmiạ mạlik do̠ pạṭhuạko ṭhen ruạṛ heć akana ar benaoic̕ do̠ arhõ noa lead book daṛeak̕a.

disputes.title: Mạlik Bipod
disputes.hint: Mit̕ṭen jạṛṛaoic̕ okoeak̕ registration do̠ duplicate lekate bạtil hoelen khan uni do̠ gạhki reak̕ mạlik do̠ okoe kanae mente biḍạu daṛeak̕a. Banar seć khon biḍạu kate bicạr me.
disputes.empty: Noa sṭeṭas sãote jãhãn jạṛuṛ do bạnuḱa.

detail.title: Bipod {{id}}
detail.noteRequired: Niạm lạgit́ mit́ṭen note ol me.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} do̠ gạhkie dohoet́ kana. Dispute do̠ bo̠nd akana ar eṭaḱ cet́ hõ baṅ bo̠do̠l akana.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}} 's ḍupliket rukhiạ nitok’ mucạt’ akana ar gạhki {{partner}} lạgit’ nawa rejisṭrạṭ lekate̱ rạjistrạ akana.
